title: New Credit Term opens with Name focused and Net X days chosen
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: a window titled "New Credit Term" opens. The cursor is in "Name" (required), with the hint "Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks." under it. Below are exactly two options, one chosen at a time: "Due Net X days" with a Days box followed by "days after the invoice date", and "Due day of the following month" with a Day box followed by "of the following month". "Due Net X days" is chosen, both boxes are empty, and the Day box is disabled. The buttons are "Cancel" and "Create Credit Term", and "Create Credit Term" is disabled. There is no option for an early-payment discount.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R1: “"New Credit Term" opens a window titled "New Credit Term"; Edit opens the same window titled "Edit Credit Term". The buttons are "Cancel" and "Create Credit Term" (New) or "Save Changes" (Edit).”
  • S3-R2: “The window holds:”
  • S3-R2, Name: “Name (required), focused on open, accepting at most 31 characters, with the hint "Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks."”
  • S3-R2, the two options: “Two options, one chosen at a time: "Due Net X days" with a Days box followed by "days after the invoice date", and "Due day of the following month" with a Day box followed by "of the following month".”
  • S3-R3: “A new term opens on "Due Net X days" with both boxes empty and the Day box disabled. Only the chosen option's box is active; the other is disabled and empty.”
  • S3-R6: “"Create Credit Term" / "Save Changes" stays disabled until the Name and the chosen box are both valid.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Name field hint | "Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks." | Hint under the field, always shown”
  • Out of Scope: “Early-payment discount terms (for example "2% 10 Net 30"). 5 insights, mostly vendor-side; not a "Net X" or "day of the following month" term. Not planned.”
  • Terminology: “The shop's own term → A term the shop created on the Credit Terms page, of one of two kinds: Due Net X days (due X days after the invoice date) or Due day of the following month (due on day X of the month after the invoice date).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "3 New credit term and Inactive tab" ("New credit term: Net X days"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p3-01-new-credit-term-net-x-days.png

The design's own words:

  • “New Credit Term opens this window. Two kinds only: "Due Net X days" (1 to 365) or "Due day of the following month" (1 to 31). No separate Due label above them. The Name field opens without any error.”
  • “Only the selected option's box is active (Days, with 14). The other option's box is greyed out (DS disabled field) and empty. Clicking a greyed box selects its option; switching clears the box you left.”
